title: List projects with usage
description: Every project the organization has reported usage for, with its name where it still exists and a deleted marker where it does not. Use it to learn which project ids a project breakdown or a team_ids filter on billing-usage-timeseries-get and billing-spend-timeseries-get can name. Beta: behind the organization-billing-api flag, and the output shape may change while it is.

methodDocumentation.text: In beta: the organization billing API is behind the organization-billing-api feature flag and answers 403 without it, so ask support for access. Its shapes may change while it is in beta. Every project the organization has reported usage for, deleted ones included, so a caller knows which ids a project breakdown or a team_ids filter can name. Below full billing access the list is the projects the caller can see.
